<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,300;9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
#mw-horeca{display:block;width:100%;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);overflow-x:clip}
#mw-horeca .e-con,#mw-horeca.e-con{--padding-top:0px;--padding-right:0px;--padding-bottom:0px;--padding-left:0px;--gap:0px;--row-gap:0px;--column-gap:0px;padding:0!important;gap:0!important;max-width:none!important}
#mw-horeca .elementor-widget,#mw-horeca .elementor-widget-container{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;width:100%}
#mw-horeca :where(h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6){color:inherit;font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;font-weight:inherit;line-height:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;text-transform:none;margin:0;padding:0}
#mw-horeca :where(p,ul,ol,li,figure,blockquote,label,span,summary,small){color:inherit;margin:0;padding:0}
#mw-horeca :where(a){color:inherit}
#mw-horeca img{border:0}
#mw-horeca>.mw-top-wrap{position:sticky;top:var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height,0px);z-index:60}
#mw-horeca :where(a){text-decoration:none}
#mw-horeca :where(button,[type=button],[type=submit]):hover,#mw-horeca :where(button,[type=button],[type=submit]):focus{background-color:revert-layer}
#mw-horeca *,#mw-horeca *::before,#mw-horeca *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
#mw-horeca img{max-width:100%;height:auto}
#mw-horeca{--paper:#F7F3EA; --white:#FFFFFF; --ink:#16140F; --mute:#5E5A52; --line:rgba(22,20,15,.12);
  --cobalt:#141414; --cobalt-deep:#000; --butter:#E6F36A; --butter-hot:#EFFA8C; --on-cta:#141414;
  --night:#0E0E0E; --on-night:#F6F3EC; --on-night-mute:rgba(246,243,236,.66); --night-line:rgba(246,243,236,.16);
  --ticket:#FFFDF6; --ticket-mute:#7B766B; --ok:#1F7A46; --bad:#B42318;
  --display:"Archivo","Arial Black",Impact,system-ui,sans-serif;
  --accent:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;
  --body:"Hanken Grotesk","Helvetica Neue",Arial,system-ui,sans-serif;
  --mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  color-scheme:light;}
#mw-horeca *,#mw-horeca *::before,#mw-horeca *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
#mw-horeca [hidden]{display:none!important}
#mw-horeca{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
#mw-horeca h1,#mw-horeca h2,#mw-horeca h3,#mw-horeca h4,#mw-horeca p,#mw-horeca ul,#mw-horeca ol,#mw-horeca figure,#mw-horeca blockquote{margin:0;padding:0}
#mw-horeca ul,#mw-horeca ol{list-style:none}
#mw-horeca a{color:inherit}
#mw-horeca button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
#mw-horeca img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
#mw-horeca :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--butter);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
#mw-horeca .wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
@media (min-width:760px){#mw-horeca .wrap{padding-left:max(36px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(36px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}}
#mw-horeca section{padding-block:clamp(72px,10vw,128px)}
#mw-horeca .kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cobalt)}
#mw-horeca .h2{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(38px,5.6vw,72px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-wrap:balance;margin-top:16px;max-width:16ch;overflow-wrap:break-word;hyphens:auto}
#mw-horeca .it{font-family:var(--accent);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;font-stretch:100%}
#mw-horeca .lede{font-size:clamp(18px,1.6vw,21px);color:var(--mute);max-width:56ch;margin-top:20px;text-wrap:pretty}
#mw-horeca .lede b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
#mw-horeca .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:60px;padding:0 30px;border-radius:999px;border:0;font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;text-decoration:none;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;transition:transform .2s var(--ease),background .2s,box-shadow .2s}
#mw-horeca .btn-go{background:var(--butter);color:var(--on-cta);box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 18px 40px -14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--butter) 75%,transparent)}
#mw-horeca .btn-go:hover{background:var(--butter-hot);transform:translateY(-2px)}
#mw-horeca .btn-go svg{width:20px;height:20px;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
#mw-horeca .btn-go:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
#mw-horeca .btn-quiet{background:transparent;color:inherit;border:2px solid currentColor;opacity:.92}
#mw-horeca .btn-quiet:hover{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-2px)}
#mw-horeca .micro{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 18px;font-size:14.5px;margin-top:16px}
#mw-horeca .micro span::before{content:"✓";font-weight:800;margin-right:6px;color:var(--butter)}
#mw-horeca .top{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:50;background:rgba(15,14,11,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);color:var(--on-night);border-bottom:1px solid var(--night-line)}
#mw-horeca .top .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;min-height:66px}
#mw-horeca .brand{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;text-decoration:none}
#mw-horeca .brand b{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.03em}
#mw-horeca .brand b i{font-style:normal;color:var(--butter)}
#mw-horeca .brand small{font-size:12px;color:var(--on-night-mute);display:none}
@media (min-width:640px){#mw-horeca .brand small{display:inline}}
#mw-horeca .top .btn{min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;font-size:15px}
#mw-horeca .hero{position:relative;color:var(--on-night);background:var(--night);padding:0;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
#mw-horeca .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 70% at 82% 40%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--cobalt) 45%,transparent),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 50% at 95% 100%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--butter) 12%,transparent),transparent 70%)}
#mw-horeca .hero .wrap{padding-block:clamp(90px,12vw,150px) clamp(56px,7vw,90px);display:grid;gap:40px;align-items:end}
@media (min-width:1000px){#mw-horeca .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 330px;align-items:center}}
#mw-horeca .hero .kicker{color:var(--butter)}
#mw-horeca .hero h1{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(56px,9vw,118px);line-height:.88;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-top:18px}
#mw-horeca .hero h1 .it{display:block;font-size:.62em;line-height:1.05;margin-top:.12em;color:var(--butter)}
#mw-horeca .hero .sub{font-size:clamp(19px,1.8vw,23px);color:var(--on-night-mute);max-width:44ch;margin-top:26px;text-wrap:pretty}
#mw-horeca .hero .sub b{color:var(--on-night);font-weight:600}
#mw-horeca .hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:34px}
@media (max-width:560px){#mw-horeca .hero-cta .btn{width:100%}}
#mw-horeca .hero .micro{color:var(--on-night-mute)}
#mw-horeca .stack{display:grid;gap:12px;justify-items:end}
@media (max-width:999px){#mw-horeca .stack{justify-items:start}
#mw-horeca .stack .ticket{width:min(260px,100%)}
#mw-horeca .stack .ticket:nth-child(n+2){display:none}}
#mw-horeca .ticket{width:250px;background:var(--ticket);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55;padding:18px 16px 22px;box-shadow:0 30px 50px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
  -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 5px at 50% 100%,transparent 98%,#000) 0 0/12px 100% repeat-x;mask:radial-gradient(circle 5px at 50% 100%,transparent 98%,#000) 0 0/12px 100% repeat-x}
#mw-horeca .ticket:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(2deg)}
#mw-horeca .ticket:nth-child(2){transform:rotate(-1.5deg) translateX(-24px)}
#mw-horeca .ticket .tt{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--ticket-mute);font-size:11px}
#mw-horeca .ticket .big{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:34px;line-height:1;margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
#mw-horeca .ticket hr{border:0;border-top:1px dashed #c5bfb2;margin:10px 0}
#mw-horeca .ticket .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
#mw-horeca .ticket .zero{color:var(--ok);font-weight:600}
#mw-horeca .ticket.in{animation:tin .8s var(--ease) both}
@keyframes tin{from{opacity:0;translate:0 -30px}to{opacity:1;translate:0 0}}
#mw-horeca .live-phone{justify-self:end;width:330px;max-width:100%}
@media (max-width:999px){#mw-horeca .live-phone{justify-self:center;width:300px}}
#mw-horeca .lp{position:relative;aspect-ratio:9/19;max-width:100%;border-radius:48px;padding:11px;background:#0a0a0a;box-shadow:0 50px 90px -40px rgba(0,0,0,.9),inset 0 0 0 2px #2c2c2c,0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
#mw-horeca .lp::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:21px;left:50%;width:92px;height:26px;margin-left:-46px;border-radius:20px;background:#000;z-index:3}
#mw-horeca .lp-screen{position:relative;height:100%;border-radius:38px;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text",var(--body);
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 70% at 20% 0%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--cobalt) 85%,#fff 15%) 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 60% at 100% 100%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--butter) 75%,#000) 0%,transparent 55%),linear-gradient(170deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--cobalt) 45%,#000),#0d0d10 60%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--butter) 14%,#000))}
#mw-horeca .lp-status{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:17px 26px 0;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:999px){#mw-horeca .lp::before{width:76px;margin-left:-38px}
#mw-horeca .lp-status{padding:17px 22px 0;font-size:11.5px}}
#mw-horeca .lp-status i{font-style:normal;letter-spacing:1px}
#mw-horeca .lp-clock{text-align:center;margin-top:22px}
#mw-horeca .lp-clock small{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;opacity:.85}
#mw-horeca .lp-clock b{display:block;font-size:68px;line-height:1;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#mw-horeca .lp-feed{position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px;top:178px;display:grid;gap:8px}
#mw-horeca .nt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(245,245,245,.78);color:#111;backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);transition:opacity .5s var(--ease),transform .5s var(--ease)}
#mw-horeca .nt .ic{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--butter);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
#mw-horeca .nt .hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:11.5px;color:#555}
#mw-horeca .nt .hd b{font-weight:600;color:#333;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.02em;font-size:10.5px}
#mw-horeca .nt .tl2{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;margin-top:1px;line-height:1.25}
#mw-horeca .nt .bd{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;color:#222;margin-top:1px}
#mw-horeca .nt .bd em{font-style:normal;color:var(--ok);font-weight:700}
#mw-horeca .nt.nt-in{animation:ntin .6s var(--ease) both}
@keyframes ntin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-22px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
#mw-horeca .nt:nth-child(4){opacity:.55;transform:scale(.96)}
#mw-horeca .nt:nth-child(n+5){display:none}
#mw-horeca .lp-sum{position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:30px;border-radius:22px;padding:12px 16px;background:rgba(15,14,11,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;text-align:center}
#mw-horeca .lp-sum b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#mw-horeca .lp-sum span{font-size:10.5px;opacity:.75}
#mw-horeca .lp-sum .z b{color:var(--butter)}
#mw-horeca .lp-home{position:absolute;bottom:9px;left:50%;width:110px;height:4px;margin-left:-55px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
#mw-horeca .lp-cap{margin-top:16px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:var(--on-night-mute)}
#mw-horeca .marquee{background:var(--butter);color:var(--on-cta);overflow:hidden;border-block:2px solid var(--on-cta);padding-block:14px}
#mw-horeca .marquee .track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:marq 38s linear infinite}
#mw-horeca .marquee span{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px);letter-spacing:-.02em;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:28px}
#mw-horeca .marquee span i{font-family:var(--accent);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;font-stretch:100%}
#mw-horeca .marquee b{font-weight:400;padding-right:28px;opacity:.55}
@keyframes marq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
#mw-horeca .works{background:var(--night);color:var(--on-night-mute);border-top:1px solid var(--night-line);padding-block:22px}
#mw-horeca .works .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px 30px;font-size:14px}
#mw-horeca .works b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--on-night);font-weight:600}
#mw-horeca .works span{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:800;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:rgba(246,243,236,.55)}
#mw-horeca .story{display:grid;gap:56px}
@media (min-width:980px){#mw-horeca .story{grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:80px;align-items:start}}
#mw-horeca .story-head{position:sticky;top:110px}
@media (max-width:979px){#mw-horeca .story-head{position:static}}
#mw-horeca .timeline{border-left:3px solid var(--ink);display:grid;gap:0}
#mw-horeca .tl{position:relative;padding:0 0 38px 30px}
#mw-horeca .tl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-9px;top:6px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);border:3px solid var(--ink)}
#mw-horeca .tl.bad::before{background:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad)}
#mw-horeca .tl time{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--cobalt)}
#mw-horeca .tl h3{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,27px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin-top:6px;text-wrap:balance}
#mw-horeca .tl p{color:var(--mute);margin-top:8px;max-width:52ch}
#mw-horeca .tl:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
#mw-horeca .verdict{margin-top:44px;padding:28px 30px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--on-night)}
#mw-horeca .verdict p{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.015em}
#mw-horeca .verdict p .it{color:var(--butter);font-size:1.12em}
#mw-horeca .verdict small{display:block;margin-top:12px;color:var(--on-night-mute);font-size:15px}
#mw-horeca .calc-band{background:#1B1A17;color:#fff}
#mw-horeca .calc-band .kicker{color:var(--butter)}
#mw-horeca .calc-band .lede{color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
#mw-horeca .calc{display:grid;gap:44px;margin-top:52px}
@media (min-width:960px){#mw-horeca .calc{grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:72px;align-items:start}
#mw-horeca .receipt{transform:rotate(1deg)}}
#mw-horeca .field{display:grid;gap:10px;padding-block:20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
#mw-horeca .field:first-child{padding-top:0}
#mw-horeca .field label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;font-weight:600;font-size:17px}
#mw-horeca .field output{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:32px;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#mw-horeca .field small{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:14px}
#mw-horeca input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:30px;background:transparent;margin:0}
#mw-horeca input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--butter) var(--fill,50%),rgba(255,255,255,.25) var(--fill,50%))}
#mw-horeca input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--butter) var(--fill,50%),rgba(255,255,255,.25) var(--fill,50%))}
#mw-horeca input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--butter);margin-top:-11px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
#mw-horeca input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--butter)}
#mw-horeca .receipt{background:var(--ticket);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;padding:30px 26px 40px;box-shadow:0 40px 70px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
  -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 7px at 50% 100%,transparent 98%,#000) 0 0/16px 100% repeat-x;mask:radial-gradient(circle 7px at 50% 100%,transparent 98%,#000) 0 0/16px 100% repeat-x}
#mw-horeca .receipt h3{text-align:center;font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-transform:uppercase}
#mw-horeca .receipt .sm{text-align:center;color:var(--ticket-mute);font-size:11.5px;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
#mw-horeca .receipt hr{border:0;border-top:1px dashed #c5bfb2;margin:14px 0}
#mw-horeca .receipt .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:3px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#mw-horeca .receipt .tot{font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
#mw-horeca .receipt .loss{color:var(--bad)}
#mw-horeca .receipt .win{color:var(--ok)}
#mw-horeca .receipt .pay{margin-top:18px;padding:16px;border:2px solid var(--ink);text-align:center;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
#mw-horeca .receipt .pay b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:52px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;text-transform:none;margin-top:6px}
#mw-horeca .calc-note{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);margin-top:22px}
#mw-horeca .calc .btn{margin-top:28px;width:100%}
#mw-horeca .method{display:grid;gap:22px;margin-top:56px}
@media (min-width:900px){#mw-horeca .method{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
#mw-horeca .m{background:var(--white);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line),0 30px 60px -45px rgba(22,20,15,.5)}
#mw-horeca .m figure{aspect-ratio:4/3;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--night)}
#mw-horeca .m figure img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
#mw-horeca .m:hover figure img{transform:scale(1.04)}
#mw-horeca .m-body{padding:26px 26px 30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
#mw-horeca .m .step{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cobalt)}
#mw-horeca .m h3{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:112%;font-weight:900;font-size:32px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.025em}
